serp_checks.reason: Three straight pulls (13, 19, 26 Oct) flagged this cluster's parent_topic as literally 'furniture bank', read as Furniture Bank Toronto's own site blocking the top organic slot. This pull's matching-terms result changed that parent_topic to 'donate furniture with free pick up toronto' and dropped this exact keyword's difficulty from 7 to 0 — the first change in four pulls — so the caveat was checked against the live SERP instead of carried forward unverified a fourth time.
serp_checks.finding: Organic position 1 is habithmd.ca (DR 38), not furniturebank.org. Full organic top 10: habithmd.ca (DR38), reddit.com/r/askTO (DR95), upstagingto.com (DR4), jewishtoronto.com/JRCC directory listing (DR57), nesto.ca (DR66), thegreenline.to (DR43), habitatrestore.ca FAQ page (DR35). furniturebank.org does not hold an organic top-10 slot for this exact phrase. The three-pull-old 'single strong incumbent' read was wrong for the organic SERP specifically.
serp_checks.but: Position 1 is a Google AI Overview citing furniturebank.org six times plus habitatrestore.ca, reddit and two others; position 2 is a three-pack local pack (Furniture Bank, Habitat ReStore, JRCC Furniture Depot); position 3 is a four-item 'people also ask' box. All three sit above the first organic result. The real constraint on this cluster is AI-Overview/local-pack/PAA interception, not a single dominant competitor — a different caveat, not no caveat.
serp_checks.verdict: Upgrade from 'borderline WINNABLE, SERP caveat' to WINNABLE NOW. No organic incumbent stronger than DR66 (Reddit's DR95 result is a thread, not a purpose-built page). State the new caveat plainly when this is commissioned: expect a lower click-through than the KD/volume numbers alone suggest, because most of the demand is answered on the SERP itself before anyone clicks.
